Q6113.reason: Arson requires malice (intent or reckless disregard of an obvious risk), and forgetting to turn off the stove is at most ordinary negligence.

Q9000.reason: GA resolutions are not binding in themselves, but they can evidence or state customary law, so they work as a material source.

Q9002.reason: The grant uses 'provided, however' language and gives a right of re-entry, not an automatic reverter, which makes it a fee simple subject to condition subsequent.
